significance: Built at Eminabad on the mound where Guru Nanak and Bhai Mardana are remembered to have rested and sung, and attributed to Bhai Wadhawa Singh in Maharaja Ranjit Singh's time. Abandoned by Sikhs after the partition of 1947 and left to decay, the building finally collapsed in flooding in July 2023.
story: Guru Nanak is said to have come here three times, and to have had a sarangi made for Bhai Mardana from the wood of a tree at Jahman village.
